comment: The panel prints AM beside the three cross ring/amplitude knobs and RM / AM beside the mix knob, while the maker's tooltips name the three knobs RM Good ↔ Bad, RM Good ← Ugly and RM Ugly → Bad and the three matching jacks AM. The code (Gbu.cpp:400-405) applies them as amplitude modulation whose depth of inversion is set by the RM / AM knob, so both names describe part of the truth; the lines here follow the panel. The Ugly oscillator cannot be modulated by the other two, only by itself (mod_phase_mix_a[2] and mod_amp_mix_a[2] are zero outside Weird mode). The Extra output is the pitch error of the Ugly oscillator in volts and is not clamped. The feedback buffer is 4096 samples long (GBU_FEEDBACK), so the delay it can reach shortens as the engine sample rate rises.
